title: Newsletter dispatcher: sending a batch of emails through a thread pool
name: Newsletter worker pool

questions.prompt: After a campaign, support noticed that when a few mailboxes bounced, the retry list contained the wrong people: customers who had received the newsletter got it again, while the ones who bounced were never retried. It only happens on larger sends, and the sent/failed totals always look right. Fix BulkDispatcher so the tests pass.

tests.content:
import threading
import unittest

from mailing.campaign import run_campaign
from mailing.dispatcher import BulkDispatcher
from mailing.sender import Message, TransportError
from mailing.suppression import SuppressionList


class FakeTransport:
    """In-memory transport. hold={"a@x": "c@x"} makes the send to a@x wait until c@x was handled."""

    def __init__(self, fail=(), hold=None):
        self.fail = set(fail)
        self.hold = hold or {}
        self.sent = []
        self.active = 0
        self.max_active = 0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._events = {}

    def _event(self, name):
        with self._lock:
            return self._events.setdefault(name, threading.Event())

    def send(self, message):
        with self._lock:
            self.active += 1
            self.max_active = max(self.max_active, self.active)
        try:
            waits_for = self.hold.get(message.to)
            if waits_for and not self._event(waits_for).wait(3):
                raise AssertionError(f"{message.to} was never released")
            if message.to in self.fail:
                raise TransportError("mailbox full")
            with self._lock:
                self.sent.append(message.to)
        finally:
            self._event(message.to).set()
            with self._lock:
                self.active -= 1


def msgs(*addresses):
    return [Message(a, "hi", "body") for a in addresses]


def people(*addresses):
    return [{"email": a, "name": a.split("@")[0]} for a in addresses]


class DispatcherTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_message_is_delivered(self):
        transport = FakeTransport()
        outcomes = BulkDispatcher(transport, workers=3).send_all(msgs("a@x", "b@x", "c@x", "d@x"))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(transport.sent), ["a@x", "b@x", "c@x", "d@x"])
        self.assertTrue(all(o.ok for o in outcomes))

    def test_failure_is_reported_not_raised(self):
        outcomes = BulkDispatcher(FakeTransport(fail={"b@x"}), workers=1).send_all(msgs("a@x", "b@x"))
        self.assertEqual([(o.to, o.ok) for o in outcomes], [("a@x", True), ("b@x", False)])
        self.assertEqual(outcomes[1].error, "mailbox full")

    def test_outcomes_line_up_with_messages_when_sends_finish_out_of_order(self):
        transport = FakeTransport(hold={"a@x": "c@x"})
        outcomes = BulkDispatcher(transport, workers=3).send_all(msgs("a@x", "b@x", "c@x"))
        self.assertEqual([o.to for o in outcomes], ["a@x", "b@x", "c@x"],
                         "outcomes must be in the same order as the messages that were sent")

    def test_retry_list_names_the_recipients_that_bounced(self):
        transport = FakeTransport(fail={"a@x"}, hold={"a@x": "c@x"})
        report = run_campaign(BulkDispatcher(transport, workers=3), people("a@x", "b@x", "c@x"), "Hi $name", "Plan: $plan")
        print("retry list:", report.retry, "(expected ['a@x'])")
        self.assertEqual(report.retry, ["a@x"])

    def test_campaign_totals(self):
        transport = FakeTransport(fail={"b@x", "d@x"})
        report = run_campaign(BulkDispatcher(transport, workers=2), people("a@x", "b@x", "c@x", "d@x"), "Hi", "Body")
        self.assertEqual((report.sent, report.failed), (2, 2))

    def test_never_more_sends_in_flight_than_workers(self):
        transport = FakeTransport()
        BulkDispatcher(transport, workers=2).send_all(msgs(*[f"u{i}@x" for i in range(10)]))
        self.assertLessEqual(transport.max_active, 2)

    def test_suppressed_addresses_are_skipped(self):
        transport = FakeTransport()
        blocked = SuppressionList(["B@x "])
        report = run_campaign(BulkDispatcher(transport, workers=2), people("a@x", "b@x", "c@x"), "Hi", "Body", blocked)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(transport.sent), ["a@x", "c@x"])
        self.assertEqual((report.sent, report.skipped), (2, 1))

    def test_messages_are_personalised(self):
        captured = []

        class Capture:
            def send_all(self, messages):
                captured.extend(messages)
                return [type("O", (), {"ok": True})() for _ in messages]

        run_campaign(Capture(), [{"email": "z@x", "name": "Zed", "plan": "pro"}], "Hello $name", "You are on $plan")
        self.assertEqual((captured[0].subject, captured[0].body), ("Hello Zed", "You are on pro"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
